conclusion: The descriptor and code symbols must be resolved from the metadata names and exact protected symbol records.
decision: Reject missing or mismatched metadata symbols; do not infer a .kd suffix or use e_entry as a kernel object.
invalidated_assumptions: Every producer uses a predictable descriptor suffix and a code-object entry point.
observation: The parser now consumes the MsgPack .symbol field and checks its protected STT_OBJECT descriptor independently from the STT_FUNC symbol.
question_or_symptom: Guessing a descriptor symbol can bind the wrong 64-byte resource record in a multi-kernel image.
